scope: New-source sensitivity and conditional independent-reference testing, not a promised improvement
units: Exact accepted prior-pilot fixed geometries and 10 m interior quadrature; no outcome-based unit selection

source.role: MERIT-derived distributor mosaic; original MERIT version not verified; comparator not independent truth
source.accumulation_units: upstream grid-cell count, not square kilometres
source.native_sampling: 3 arc seconds in EPSG:4326; categorical directions sampled with nearest cell only

comparisons.sampling: Project each geographic cell-centre and its downstream endpoint into the case metric CRS, then normalize; do not interpolate D8 codes
comparisons.primary_direction_disagreement: cosine <= 0, i.e. at least 90 degrees on paired valid vectors
comparisons.secondary: absolute angle > 45 degrees; any angle > 1 degree; per-unit majority of positive tangent projections, ties unknown
comparisons.denominators: All fixed samples, available vectors per source, paired samples, fixed units, orientable unit pairs and distinct native MERIT cells; correlated samples are not independent trials
comparisons.registration_stress: At each nonzero distance use four cardinal shifts of MERIT sample positions only; a robustness stress, not a measured registration residual
comparisons.water_warning: Reuse frozen prior primary clear gate >=0.8 and max MNDWI near-water fraction over -0.1,0,+0.1 <0.2; warning association with comparator disagreement is not error precision
comparisons.clerical_correction: The initial ed27b42 text accidentally said0.5; corrected to the actual unchanged pilot threshold0.2 after checking its source protocol, before comparator scoring; no threshold selected from outcomes
comparisons.ablation: Report water/vegetation/morphology flags independently alongside the old final categories, avoiding gate-preemption; do not invent a learned fusion score
comparisons.statistics: Case-level descriptive comparisons only; no pixel-independent confidence intervals or favorable threshold selection

physical_reference.priority: Official published ADCP observed interior flow vectors, independently sourced outlet inputs
physical_reference.status_at_freeze: Attachment access unresolved; no measurement rows read
physical_reference.sacramento_glenn_2023: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: source metadata exposed aggregate signed velocity ranges; not unread/blinded
physical_reference.allegheny_2021_2022: Prospective reference; schema/access only, do not read values before a separate frozen reference-specific protocol
physical_reference.rule: No physical direction accuracy, routing-error precision/recall, outlet gain, calibration or geographic transfer claim without compatible observed labels and disjoint predictor sources

definition_of_done: per-claim verdict and access gaps documented
